name: SpaceX Starlink Data Source
description: Request-builder and parser flow nodes for SpaceX Starlink operator ephemeris (the public MEME files at api.starlink.com/public-files/ephemerides) as SDS $OEM for the OD flow (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON and no base64). plan turns a TimerTick into the MANIFEST.txt HttpRequest; select_objects reads the manifest's HttpResponse and emits one HttpRequest per MEME file in the configured window (objectCap, offset, count; default the whole constellation), each a leading byte range (rangeBytes, default 131072: the ~2-3 orbit fit window; 0 = the whole file), 16 per invocation, the rest yielded as backlog (probe: a FlowNotice Info with the object count instead); emit parses each MEME HttpResponse into one SDS $OEM with exact row epochs and full supplied covariance (EME2000 states, UTC), in memory only - nothing is stored, signed or published. JOB STATE TRAVELS AS HttpRequest.CONTEXT: one size-prefixed $OEM header record naming the object, echoed by hostcap/http-request; pairing is by CONTEXT. Node CONFIG through plugin.getConfig (SDS $PIV, one ModuleConfig on raw "config"): manifestUrl, objectCap, offset, count, rangeBytes, probe, timeoutMs. No credentials: capabilities none.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method turns its typed frames into output frames in one pass: plan emits one request, select_objects queues one request per object and hands them out 16 an invocation as the compiled runtime resumes the yielded node, emit parses each response it is given. The only state is the request queue; no worker pool and no thread.

methods.description: TimerTick -> the HttpRequest for the ephemeris MANIFEST.txt (manifestUrl). One tick per invocation (a surplus is refused as batched-input-frames); its fields are not read.

acceptedTypeSets.description: TimerTick (module-sdk runtime type TICK) from the flow's timer trigger.
HttpRequest (HREQ) for hostcap/http-request: GET MANIFEST.txt, no CONTEXT.

methods.description: The manifest's HttpResponse -> one HttpRequest per MEME file in [offset, offset+count) of the first objectCap entries (objectCap <= 0 or unset: the whole manifest), GET with range bytes=0-(rangeBytes-1) unless rangeBytes is 0, 16 per invocation, the rest yielded as backlog and resumed without input. probe: a FlowNotice Info (REASON object-count, COUNT the objects covered) and no requests. A manifest not answered 200 is a FlowNotice Missing (manifest-unavailable); an empty window a FlowNotice Skipped (nothing-to-fetch).

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request: BODY the MANIFEST.txt listing, one MEME filename a line.

inputPorts.description: The manifest response (none: resume the yielded backlog).

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpRequest (HREQ) for hostcap/http-request: GET <base>/<MEME filename>, range bytes=0-(rangeBytes-1) unless rangeBytes is 0; CONTEXT: the job, one size-prefixed $OEM header record (one ephemeris data block whose OBJECT carries OBJECT_NAME and NORAD_CAT_ID from the MEME filename; no states).
FlowNotice (FNTC): Info (object-count, COUNT), Missing (manifest-unavailable, ITEMS the URL and status), Skipped (nothing-to-fetch).

outputPorts.description: Why the pass emitted no requests.

methods.description: The MEME files' HttpResponses with object headers in CONTEXT become SDS OEM records. Exact UTC row epochs, EME2000 states in km and km/s, and all 21 supplied covariance entries with their declared UVW or EME2000 frame are preserved. Missing covariance remains absent. No uniform-grid assumption or covariance repair. Malformed or mixed covariance availability is a Missing notice with the reason. A partial HTTP range omits its incomplete trailing record and records that omission in the OEM comment. Identity comes from the manifest job. Nothing is stored, signed or published.

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request: STATUS 200 or 206, BODY the MEME text (or its leading range), CONTEXT the job select_objects sent.

inputPorts.description: Object responses, in any order (paired by CONTEXT).

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $OEM (not size-prefixed), one per object; consumed in memory by analysis/od fit, never stored.
FlowNotice (FNTC): Missing (objects-unavailable, ITEMS '<OBJECT_NAME> (<NORAD>): HTTP <status>' or ': no state vectors').
